conditions: Discovery failure retried after original native retirement

ownership: Controller owns at most one retry record per admitted device key; confirmed inventory detach removes records, unavailable inventory preserves cutoffs. Retirement modifies only an existing retry record, preventing late owners from resurrecting a detached key. Existing link/native-completion/pairing gates still precede release. No new thread or native resource.
policy: Automatic candidates must already be Android accessories, remain available and have no live/retiring link. Startup failures back off 2/4/8/16/32/60 seconds; authentication clears history. Native discovery without Hello suppresses until confirmed replug or manual Connect. No normal-mode hardware hints are persisted.
limits: No connected USB devices probed. Normal-mode tablet mode-switch requires explicit Connect; accessory identity is scheduling evidence only, never authentication.
